answer: Before an agent may attest, it must post a stake bond, and its votes count only when a random panel of unrelated peers co-signs them. Ten thousand sybils therefore need ten thousand locked stakes, not ten thousand free keys, and a cluster caught voting together is slashed, burning those stakes. The cost stays linear: no velvet subsidy for scale and no broad mesa of cheap identities to hide behind, so every fake seat is as expensive as a real one. The price is crystal clear, and auditors can trace the ring.
